integrity: Self-contained analytic argument with exact small-graph arithmetic and finite numerical diagnostics; finite tests are not proof of the general theorem.
scientific_limitations: Only two complete-graph factors with unit per-edge price; fixed-order scaling requires fixed smaller factor and order; joint-order scaling uses the stated logarithmic regime. The p=1,m=2 prism subcase is already known and not claimed novel. Primary full text of one close indexed record was unavailable; independent audit not performed.
title: Continuous spectral-order allocation on rectangular rook networks
